issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts float id values (truncates to int silently)

triage_summary.root_cause: int() in Python silently truncates float values without warning, and bool is a subclass of int
risk_points: Data loss: float values like 1.5 silently become 1
False sense of validation: code appears to validate but corrupts data
Bool edge case: True/False accepted as 1/0

fix_summary.approach: Add explicit type checking before int() conversion
changes: Check if value is bool (reject with clear error)
Check if value is float (reject with clear error)
Check if value is int (accept directly)
Otherwise try string conversion via int()
